## TemplateManager.getGInvoice() method

Gets compiled from block <g-invoice>.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getGInvoice(key: string, AGBaseId?: string, ALang?: string, data?: Record<string, unknown>): ReturnType<ITCompiledTemplate[`invoice`][`default`][`default`]>;
```

**Returns:**

ReturnType&lt;[ITCompiledTemplate](./gramstax.itcompiledtemplate.md)<!-- -->\[\`invoice\`\]\[\`default\`\]\[\`default\`\]&gt;

Invoice object containing title, description, payload, currency, and prices

## Remarks

Retrieves the compiled invoice function for the specified template and language, then executes it with the provided data to generate the invoice payload.

## Example


```typescript
const invoice = tm.getGInvoice("vip-page", "default", "en", {orderId: "o-1"})
// => {title: "...", description: "...", payload: "o-1", currency: "XTR", prices: [{label: "...", amount: 100}]}
```
